scope: Proposition 2.6 (Spherical profiles) of the manuscript “Smooth counterexamples to Yau's nodal upper bound in dimensions three and four” (preprints/Smooth-counterexamples-to-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-in-dimensions-three-and-four-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e4c129bdb0f2f45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a C2 neighborhood U of g∗ such that the following holds. For every smooth g ∈ U, every 1/5 ≤ t ≤ 3/10, and every T, ε > 0, there is a smooth real function ϕ on S3 with ϕ0 = log t + r2 − t2 , supp(ϕ − ϕ0) ⋐ Ω, ∥ϕ − ϕ0∥C0 < ε, such that 1. ϕ is strict on r ≤ 3/10; 2. its critical points in this region are exactly r = 0, and at each such point Hϕ is positive on a two-plane; 3. ϕ > log r for 0 < r < t, while ϕ < log r for t < r ≤ 1; 4. Z Ω |aϕ| dVg > T. The metric-coordinate comparison constants on Ω, including the Lipschitz constants of its two- coordinate projections for the ambient Riemannian distance, can be chosen uniformly for g ∈ U. In particular, Z Ω Lϕ dx ≥ c Z Ω |aϕ| dVg (2.10) with one constant c > 0 for this neighborhood. Each constructed profile is fixed before a wave frequency is chosen.
